query:
UPDATE work_items
SET status = $4,
    finished_at = CASE WHEN $4 = 'failed' THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
    lease_owner = NULL,
    lease_expires_at = NULL,
    heartbeat_at = NULL,
    last_error = $5,
    run_after = CASE WHEN $4 = 'pending' THEN $6 ELSE run_after END,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND lease_owner = $3 AND status = 'running'
